leah (PM): Quick spike: customers want per-route saved queries to remember the model pin AND filter state per-model. Current console only persists filters at the route level and forgets model-specific tweaks. This causes surprise when switching models in the Compare view. Can we agree API + telemetry shape?

mo (eng): Yeah we've seen bugs. Current endpoints: `GET /routes/{id}/saved_queries` returns `filters` and `model_id` separately, but clients merge them lazily which loses association.

jin (platform): Proposal: canonicalize to an array of scoped entries: `saved_queries[].scope_targets` where each target = `{model_id, filters}`. But keep it flat in response, e.g., `targets:["m1:filterhash","m2:filterhash"]` to avoid nested objects.

maya (design): UX requirement: when a user selects a saved query in a route, the console should also restore the pinned model if the query was saved with one. We need a tiny badge "pinned to mX" and a quick toggle "use without switching model".

mo (eng): Implementation concern: switching model can trigger Dedicated fallback logic and change token cost. We need to show a preview cost delta when restoring a saved query that would switch models. Add `preview_cost_delta` to the saved_query object.

pete (sre): Telemetry: we currently sample route-level query loads at 10%. For model-scoped restores we should increase sampling to 100% during the rollout window so we can measure cost regressions. Suggest new event `saved_query.restore.v2` with fields: `query_id`, `route_id`, `model_id`, `effective_model_id`, `preview_cost_delta`, `user_id`, `flag_rollout`.

leah (PM): Rollout plan: 1) Add API fields read-only and console reads them but doesn't change behavior (2) 7-day shadow telemetry with sampling=100% for `saved_query.restore.v2` for 10% orgs (3) enable UX for 10% orgs with feature flag `mq_restore_v1` (model-quest restore) (4) full rollout if metrics ok.

jin (platform): Backcompat: keep old `model_id` and `filters` top-level for 30 days and add `model_pinned` boolean + `preview_cost_delta` numeric. Also include header `X-SQ-Schema:v1-beta`.

mo (eng): Client changes: map new `model_pinned` -> show badge; if `preview_cost_delta > threshold` show confirmation modal before switching. We'll add unit/integration tests for mapping.

maya (design): Modal copy: "Switching to model {m} will increase token cost by {X}% per request. Continue?" Add small link "Preview token calc".

pete (sre): Alerting: if during shadow telemetry we see average `preview_cost_delta` > 20% or error-rate for restores increases by >2x, abort rollout. I'll create Grafana panels for median delta and restore error-rate.

mo (eng): One more API ask: we need a compact stable key to tie filters to models for diffing. Suggest `filter_hash` string on the saved target. That keeps response flat and easy to index.

jin (platform): Ok will include `filter_hash`, `model_pinned`, `preview_cost_delta`, and `fallback_hint` string if fallback model will be used. Prod shim plan: return both shapes for two weeks.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview started for `platform/sq-modelpin-shim` at 2026-02-01T18:04:12Z :rocket:

leah (PM): Action items: jin PR today, mo client mapping + tests, maya copy + badge mock, pete dashboards/alerts. Quick check-in after deploy preview tomorrow.

mo (eng): I'll add E2E test that saves a query with model pinned, then restores across model compatibility matrix to ensure fallback_hint surfaces.

maya (design): I'll post two mock screenshots: (1) saved query list with "pinned to mX" badge and (2) restore confirmation modal.

pete (sre): I'll add shadow telemetry dashboard and set Pager rule `sq_restore_cost_regression` with threshold config.

leah (PM): Thanks all. If anyone sees unexpected token burn in staging ping #eng-oncall.
